text:
Really interesting, and I think you’re going to need to charge more for your product (which may come up during your funding rounds). I’ve been building the same thing at $enterprise, totally on-prem multi-AZ, multi-region KaaS, VMaaS, and soon DBaaS, and some of the other services listed. It’s a great deal harder than we initially planned for and we have some ridiculous internal policies that require everything to be git-driven which makes it worse.

Looking forward to see how your product develops. Would love to work with you in future.
